transcript: Welcome to the California Sun podcast. I'm your host, Jeff Shekman. It's often said that California is a preview of America's future. He joins me today to talk about California's challenges, the consequences of current federal policies, and why it matters deeply to all of us inside California and beyond. It is my pleasure to welcome Congressman John Garamende here to the California Sun Podcast. Congressman, thanks so much for joining us.
